in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ray of light, Radiance

In Hindu mythology, Kirana is the name of a celestial being, a ray of light sent by the god Indra to illuminate the darkness. It is also a name of the god Vishnu, representing his divine light.
